translation: Took place in posad Serock, 21 August 1890, 7 AM. Appeared personally Jankiel [unclear: Bornsztejn/Berensztejn], joiner, 26, and Berek Kołtun, laborer, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 2 PM in posad Serock died Moszek [unclear: Zinderman/Zunderman], one year six months of age, son of [unclear: Eljusz/Eliasz] and Szajna Sura. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of [unclear: Zinderman] this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
